query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('6ec4acc3fbbd570ada625f24902777cec5d7a349fa0f3c7ba87b0cff', '97f1732964905b3c71d12163968814ac5f3be77abc94830a84d32cf9')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
